title: Users
description: Accounts, roles and employee links — who can sign in, and as what.

table.empty: No users match. Create the first account to give someone access.
table.swipe: Swipe sideways to see every user field.
table.label: Users
table.containerLabel: Users. Scroll horizontally to read all columns.

form.createDescription: Create an account with an initial password; roles are the fixed six.
form.editDescription: Email, role and the employee link apply on the next request — sessions re-resolve per request.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 10 characters

deactivate.title: Deactivate user
deactivate.description: {email} loses access immediately — sign-in is rejected and every session stops resolving. Their account and history are kept; activation restores access.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.description: Set a new password for {email}. It applies immediately and signs out every existing session of the account.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailTaken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.employeeLinkTaken: This employee is already linked to a user.
errors.employeeNotFound: The selected employee no longer exists.
errors.lastAdmin: The last active admin or super admin cannot be deactivated.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to manage users.
